resources.string: Modern Xposed module for Facebook: ad-free feed, media download, account tools
Module loaded. Enable it in LSPosed for com.facebook.katana, then restart Facebook.
Khởi động lại Facebook để áp dụng thay đổi.

Hook points are resolved at runtime and logged inside the Facebook process. View the report with:

adb logcat -s FacebookAppAdsRemover FBAR.Discovery

Each target logs FOUND / NOT_UNIQUE / NOT_FOUND with the resolved method descriptor.
